entry.title: Where are the new M+ portals in WoW 11.1 Season 2
entry.summary:
In the latest World of Warcraft: The War Within Season 2 Undermine(d) update, you can once again traverse the Timeways from Dragonflight to easily reach portals to past Mythic+ dungeons that are part of this rotation. Here is where you can find the new M+ portals in WoW 11.1 Season 2.
Where the New Mythic+ Dungeon portals are located
You can access the new Mythic+ dungeon portals that lead to previous expansion's M+ dungeons in WoW by visiting the Timeways via a portal in the Stoneshaper's Atrium in Dornogal on the Isle of Dorn, as indicated on the map above.
Once there, right click on the portal and you will be taken to the Timeways, an area introduced in the Dragonflight expansion that is updated with portals for previous expansion dungeons that are part of this season's M+ rotation. Once inside, you will see three portals that lead to three different zones and dungeons:
Left Portal: Operation: Mechagon Workshop dungeon in Mechagon
Center Portal: Theater of Pain dungeon in Maldraxxus
Right Portal: The MOTHERLODE!! dungeon in Isle of Kezan
For Season 2 of World of Warcraft: The War Within, four of the M+ dungeons in this season's rotation are simply from The War Within expansion, meaning you can get to them throughout Dornogal. This includes Cindrew Meadery in Isle of Dorn, Darkflame Cleft in The Ringing Deeps, The Rookery in Isle of Dorn, and Priory of the Sacred Flame in Hallowfall.
The eighth and final dungeon as part of the WoW Season 2 M+ dungeon rotation is the new Operation: Floodgate which can be accessed in the new Undermine zone that was introduced in this update.
By this logic, it's best to set your Hearthstone to Dornogal for this update, as you can easily reach each dungeon from the capital city either by flying to the appropriate region, teleporting to Undermine via the portal in Dornogal, or accessing the Timeways to reach the old expansion dungeons.

entry.title: How to get the free Black Widow costume in Marvel Rivals
entry.summary:
The Galacta's Cosmic Event is ongoing in Marvel Rivals at the time of writing, from which you can get a Black Widow costume for absolutely no extra cost.
The name of the costume is "Mrs. Barnes," and it's the last reward of the event's track. If you're wondering how to get it, here's everything you need to know.
How to get the Mrs. Barnes Black Widow costume in Marvel Rivals
To get the free Mrs. Barnes Black Widow costume, all you need to do is participate in the Galacta's Cosmic Event board game, which consists of 22 blocks in total.
Screenshot by Destructoid
Since it's a board game, a die is involved – meaning the number you get when it's rolled is completely random. There's a chance of missing it completely in the first run in case the die rolls a number that skips the free cosmetic.
In that case, you have to keep rolling from the start with the hope of landing on it at some point. In other words, there's a bit of luck involved in getting hands on the free Mrs. Barnes Black Widow costume in Marvel Rivals.
How to get more die rolls
You need to collect 30 Galacta’s Power Cosmic to get an additional die roll. All you need to do is complete the Galacta's Cosmic Event Challenges to get this item.
Apart from that, you also get up to four free die rolls (one every 24 hours). This is only for a limited period – till March 16, 2025, at 2 a.m. PT.
The event ends on the same day as Season 1, which means that at the time of writing, you have over 30 days to get all the rewards.

entry.title: Triple-i Initiative returns for 2025 with ‘no ads, no hosts, just games’
entry.summary:
Last year saw Evil Empire kick off The Triple-i Initiative showcase, an event focused on announcements for indie games. Now the spotlight is back on the indie world in a second edition that promises “no ads, no hosts, just games.”
There’s no date in place yet for the 2025 edition of the Triple-i Initiative, but we have some idea of what type of presentation to expect. According to the press release and the teaser video below, this year’s event will feature a mix of launch date reveals, gameplay first looks, and world premieres.
In addition to a tease of “out of nowhere reveals,” Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core, The Alters, Endless Legend 2, No, I’m Not A Human, and Enshrouded will be among the titles on display.
Evil Empire admits that The Triple-i Initiative started as an idea to announce The Rogue Prince of Persia. From there, additional studios got in on the plans to show off what’s in store in the future. Last year’s reveals also included news for Slay the Spire 2, Cataclismo, Risk of Rain 2, Palworld, and Vampire Survivors.
As for Evil Empire themselves, Marketing Director Bérenger Dupré says they don’t have a “flashy new game to unveil” this time around. They still wanted to get all the other studios together again, though. “Dropping all these announcements from our corner of the gaming world in one big blast makes sure the entire show is fun to watch for our players, and for us too!” Dupré commented.
We may not know when this is all going down, but we know where, at the very least. You’ll be able to watch The Triple-i Initiative 2025 on YouTube and Twitch, as well as concurrent streams via IGN, Gamespot, and Steam.

entry.title: How to mine Gold Veins in Fortnite
entry.summary:
It's very satisfying to pick up a bunch of gold bars in Fortnite and go on a spending spree. If you break gold rock veins, you'll even get a handy speed boost to help you charge toward other players and secure some easy eliminations.
However, you won't find these gold veins just anywhere. Although they spawn often on the map, you'll have to visit specific spots to take full advantage of them. Here's how to find gold veins for your weekly and event quests.
Where to find Gold Veins in Fortnite Chapter 6, Season 2
The best way to find gold veins in Fortnite is to travel around the gold-infused rivers near Crime City and Shiny Shafts. This region on the map's west side has golden mountains, rocks, and water flowing throughout it, with gold vein rocks dotted along the river's edges.
Screenshot by Destructoid
Screenshot by Destructoid
Gold veins appear as dark grey and gold rocks that shimmer as you approach them. Unlike regular boulders, these rocks have much more obvious gold chunks sticking out of them, with small gold sparkles emanating from them. Once you see them, they become pretty easy to spot later.
Each rock has 250 health, so you can quickly break them with your pickaxe or your preferred weapon. Having Gold Rush makes them even easier to break, so you won't have to worry about spending several minutes standing around and hitting rocks.
You'll often find clusters around Crime City and Shiny Shafts' waters, giving you an easy way to complete your weekly quests. The gold veins also drop the Gold Rush buff that boosts your movement speed and around 30 Gold Bars per rock, letting you farm some cash if you plan on visiting a nearby Black Market or vending machine.

entry.title: How to evolve superstars in WWE 2K25

WWE 2K25's MyFaction mode can be a huge grind if you don't have cards of higher rarities, but the ability to evolve some of your existing items will certainly help you in the process.

WWE 2K25 Superstar Evolutions explained
Every wrestler card in MyFaction belongs to a certain rarity, starting from Bronze. The lower the rarity, the weaker its stats are. Cards that can evolve will improve their rarity and in-game stats. It's easy to identify cards that can evolve, as they have DNA symbols on their left side.

The number of tasks that you have to complete can also vary. Usually, cards can evolve by only one tier, but it's still handy for improving your Faction. Getting higher-tier cards at the start of your MyFaction adventures is hard, so having a card that can upgrade by at least one rarity will be helpful.
For starters, we all receive two cards that can be upgraded. One will belong to men's wrestling and one to women's wrestling. I am sure we will get plenty more upgradeable cards in the future, as some are also available in the packs.
Certain wrestlers also have Persona cards available in the game, and you can get them to unlock alternative appearances for your superstars. Make sure to check this guide out to learn more about how to get all the available Persona cards in WWE 2K25.

entry.title: How to find 3 Golden Llamas in Fortnite
entry.summary:
Have you ever encountered a Golden Llama in Fortnite's modes? Although regular llamas occasionally appear as rare loot sources, golden versions are almost unheard of except during various events. Considering Chapter 6, Season 2 is all about gold, this one feels particularly fitting.
How to find Golden Llamas in Fortnite Chapter 6, Season 2
Golden Llamas are rare loot containers that spawn randomly around Fortnite's map. Since they have random spawns, there's no one specific location to camp if you wish to find them as part of a weekly quest or event. Instead, your goal is to survive as long as possible and move around the map in hopes of spotting one of these in the wild.
Screenshot by Destructoid
Golden Llamas appear as a goofy-looking gold llama that's slightly smaller than the player's model. If you're familiar with the game's rainbow versions from previous seasons, they look almost the exact same with a distinct color change.
Since Golden Llamas can spawn anywhere, there's a chance you'll encounter them in strange spots like the sides of cliffs, near the edge of the map, or on top of massive mountains. I even found one of a cliff's edge that I could barely navigate, making it a little tricky to search it for loot. Sometimes, it requires a bit of trial and error.
If you're focused on completing your quests and don't mind risking a loss or two, you can start gliding from the Battle Bus immediately after jumping out to help you search for Golden Llamas from a bird's-eye view. Although you won't reach the ground as quickly, you might get lucky and spot one from the skies, letting you drop to its exact spot and claim it before someone else accidentally stumbles upon it. Otherwise, you can just play your matches normally and hope you find one by chance.

entry.title: Monster Hunter needs a full-scale rebirth, but its contradictions are fascinating
entry.summary:
Monster Hunter Wilds is the fastest-selling game in Capcom's history. It continues to lord over the Steam charts, with peaks that might cause Counter-Strike 2 to glance momentarily down from its Olympus of user-created hats, and while people are still booting the dung out of the PC version's performance, verdicts upon the beast-punching as a whole are glowing.
To suggest that now is the time to go back to formula is probably pure contrarianism, but Wilds makes my brain itch. Building on (and hopefully not just recapping) Brendy's excellently ambivalent Monster Hunter Wilds review, I think the series is balancing on the edges of contradictions that extend throughout its design, from the combat through the user interface to the world and narrative themes. I think it's been doing that for years, in fact, but Wilds, for me, is where Monster Hunter's confusion about itself has come to a head.

Years ago I wrote a piece about what I presumptuously defined as the "emerging" subgenre of city games that respond to the climate crisis, with its attendant catastrophes of unchecked capitalism and resurgent fascism. Today, it feels dangerously like that subgenre is "sub" no longer. We are engulfed in strategy sims where society is the rind between the formless terrors without and the only-human abusers within. entry.title: Na trhu chybí tisíce odborníků na čipy. FEKT VUT proto otevře nový studijní program, který v Česku nemá obdoby
entry.summary: Okolo tří tisíc odborníků v Česku a až padesát tisíc specialistů v rámci Evropy. Taková je přibližně podle Viléma Kledrowetze z Ústavu mikroelektroniky FEKT VUT stávající poptávka po lidech v oblasti čipů a moderních polovodičů. I proto letos v září na fakultě otevřou ojedinělý bakalářský a magisterský program, který bude právě na tuto oblast zaměřen. Propojí teorii s praxí, nabídne zkušenosti odborníků z jiných fakult a z průmyslu i množství zajímavých stáží v Česku a ve světě.
